caption: The drawing depicts a single, tall, transparent vessel or glass placed centrally against a plain, beige background. The vessel has an outwardly flaring rim, a narrow middle section, and a subtly widened base. The surface of the vessel features a pattern of alternating diagonal blue and white spirals that wrap around the form from the base up to the rim. The blue bands vary slightly in hue and intensity, and the transparent effect on the vessel allows for some light interplay with these bands. There are no other objects or decorative elements in the image, and the background remains uniformly blank, with some signs of minor discoloration along the bottom and right edges.
title: Vase (Blue and White)
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
